values.description: Base URL for the FX rates provider. Switch to https://api.frankfurter.app if open.er-api.com is unavailable.
Base currency for the current run. Set by the Collection Runner from fx-rates-data.csv, or overridden manually for a single request.
Captured rate: how many EUR one USD buys. Set by the first request (GET base currency) and consumed by the EUR cross-check request. Empty before the first request runs.
Unix timestamp of the last rate update, captured from time_last_update_unix in the response. Used for audit and freshness checks.
